data.description: The Zig Zag Slide changes direction more than once on its way down, with sharp turns in a red and yellow chute that starts at a 5 ft steel ladder. Children are pushed from side to side at each turn, which gives a lively ride for its height. The zig zag shape also catches the eye in a society garden or park. Because the slide doubles back, it takes less length than a straight slide with the same drop. That helps on a narrow site. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry our standard 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Tell us about your site and we will mark the slide on a layout drawing.

items.pText: The Zig Zag Slide changes direction more than once on its way down, with sharp turns in a red and yellow chute that starts at a 5 ft steel ladder. Children are pushed from side to side at each turn, which gives a lively ride for its height. The zig zag shape also catches the eye in a society garden or park. Because the slide doubles back, it takes less length than a straight slide with the same drop. That helps on a narrow site. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry our standard 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Tell us about your site and we will mark the slide on a layout drawing.

Its galvanised steel ladder feeds a moulded zig zag bed. It goes in self-standing or grouted. Keep a clear landing zone at the exit, use an impact-absorbing surface under the slide, and check each turn and joint for cracks or gaps during routine maintenance.
